scope: Physical Fortnite venues relevant to France and Europe

principles.stable_venue_id: A venue_id is immutable across events; renames become aliases/history rather than a new venue when the physical venue is the same.
principles.address_precision: Never invent street, postal code, entrance or GEO. Store the most precise officially verified level only.
principles.geo_guard: GEO requires a direct venue/organizer source or another authoritative geocoding source explicitly recorded in geo_source.
principles.city_only_is_valid: CITY precision is valid when the organizer has announced only the city; do not upgrade it from third-party speculation.
principles.entrance_is_session_specific: A special gate/entrance belongs to event access data unless the venue permanently identifies it.
